questions.text: When the web server receives an HTTP request for a PHP page, the web server calls the _____________.
questions.explanation:
PHP is server-side code. When a PHP page is requested, the web server passes the PHP code to the PHP interpreter so it can execute the script and produce output, usually HTML, for the browser.

Student note: Apache is the web server; PHP is the interpreter that executes the PHP script. Keep those two roles separate.

questions.text: Which of the following software is a web browser?
questions.explanation:
Google Chrome is a web browser used by a client to request and display web pages. phpMyAdmin is a database administration tool, Outlook is an email application, and Apache is a web server.

Student note: A browser runs on the client side; a web server such as Apache responds to browser requests.

questions.text: The first part of a URL is called the ___________.
questions.explanation:
A URL normally starts with the protocol or scheme, such as http:// or https://. It tells the browser how to communicate with the resource.

Student note: In https://example.com/page.php, https is the protocol, example.com is the domain, and page.php is the file or resource path.

questions.text: Which of the following is not a database server that can be used for dynamic web pages?
questions.explanation:
MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle are database management systems. Python is a programming language, not a database server.

Student note: A programming language can connect to a database, but that does not make the language itself a database server.

The == operator compares values after PHP type juggling, so 10 == 10 and "10" == 10 are both true. The === operator compares both value and type, so integer 10 is not identical to string "10". var_export(..., true) returns the words true or false.

Student note: == means equal value; === means equal value AND equal data type.

questions.text: Which one of the following statements stores 0 in $result after execution?
questions.explanation:
The modulus operator % gives the remainder. 10 % 2 is 0 because 10 divides exactly by 2. Then 0 * 2 remains 0.

Student note: Remember normal operator precedence: multiplication, division and modulus are evaluated before addition and subtraction.

questions.text:
Study the SQL query below:

```sql
SELECT vendorName, invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, invoiceTotal
FROM vendors INNER JOIN invoices
ON vendors = invoices
WHERE invoiceTotal >= 500
ORDER BY vendorName
```

If vendorName contains string data and invoiceTotal contains decimal values, how will the result set be ordered?
questions.explanation:
ORDER BY vendorName sorts by the vendorName column. Because no DESC keyword is supplied, SQL uses ascending order by default, so text values are arranged alphabetically from A onward.

Student note: ASC is the default. DESC must be written when you want the reverse order.

questions.text: When you code a DELETE statement, you usually need to include ___________.
questions.explanation:
A WHERE clause limits which rows are deleted. Without it, a DELETE statement can remove every row in the table.

Student note: Before running DELETE or UPDATE, always check the WHERE condition carefully because it controls which records are affected.

questions.text: Which of the following is incorrect regarding relational databases?
options: A database can have multiple tables
A database table can have many primary keys
A database table can have many foreign keys
A database table can have many rows and columns
questions.correctAnswer: A database table can have many primary keys
questions.explanation:
A table has one primary-key constraint, although that primary key may be made from more than one column. A table may contain many foreign keys and many rows and columns.

Student note: Do not confuse a composite primary key with 'many primary keys'. A composite key is still one primary key made from several columns.

questions.text: Which is a data type used for a column in a database table?
questions.explanation:
INT is a database data type used for whole numbers. PRIMARY, FOREIGN and INDEX describe keys or indexing concepts rather than column data types.

Student note: Common SQL data types include INT, VARCHAR, DATE and DECIMAL.

questions.text: Which type of SQL statement returns a result set?
questions.explanation:
SELECT retrieves rows and columns from a database and returns them as a result set. INSERT adds data, UPDATE changes data, and CREATE defines database objects.

Student note: Think SELECT = read, INSERT = add, UPDATE = change, DELETE = remove.

questions.text: Which one of the following is incorrect about PDO?
options: PDO facilitates database access in PHP
Creation of a PDO object can result in errors that can be handled using a try/catch statement
One can specify the name of the database table when creating a PDO object
A PDO object can be created using three arguments
questions.correctAnswer: One can specify the name of the database table when creating a PDO object
questions.explanation:
A PDO connection is created for a database connection, normally using a DSN plus username and password. You do not choose a particular table in the PDO constructor; tables are referenced later in SQL statements.

Student note: PDO connects PHP to the database. SQL statements decide which table and rows you work with.

questions.text: In the catch block of a try/catch statement for handling PDO exceptions, you can get a message that describes the exception by using the getMessage() method of the _____.
questions.explanation:
Database connection or PDO errors can be represented by a PDOException. Calling getMessage() on that exception object returns the error message.

Student note: The catch variable represents the exception that was thrown; getMessage() is called on that exception object.

questions.text: What does the acronym MVC stand for?
questions.explanation:
MVC stands for Model-View-Controller. It separates data and business logic (Model), the user interface (View), and request coordination (Controller).

Student note: Learn the responsibility of each part, not only the three words.

questions.text: Which component of MVC contains code to access database in a web application?
questions.explanation:
The Model represents application data and business rules and normally contains or calls the data-access logic. The View presents information and the Controller handles requests and coordinates work.

Student note: Database work belongs with the model/data layer, not directly inside the page used to display the interface.

questions.text: When you use the MVC pattern, the ________________ consists of the HTML and PHP files that make up the user interface of the application.
questions.explanation:
The View is the presentation part of MVC. It contains the interface that the user sees and interacts with, often built with HTML and presentation-focused PHP.

Student note: View = what the user sees; Model = data/business logic; Controller = request coordinator.

questions.text: When you use the MVC pattern, the controller gets the HTTP requests and then directs the use of the files that represent ____________.
options: the model, the view and the database
the model, the view and the user interface
questions.explanation:
The Controller receives the request, calls the appropriate Model logic, and selects or coordinates the View used to return a response.

Student note: In MVC the controller coordinates the model and view; it should not replace them.

questions.text: When you use the MVC pattern, _________________.
options: all the PHP code is in the controller
the pattern is used in every PHP file of the application
it is easier to test and debug the application
questions.correctAnswer: it is easier to test and debug the application
questions.explanation:
MVC separates responsibilities, which makes parts of the application easier to understand, change, test and debug independently.

Student note: MVC improves structure and maintainability; it does not automatically guarantee faster execution.
